words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算机做作业。
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.tr:
n. 服务；
v. 保养；
words.ex: The restaurant offers excellent service.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供出色的服务。
words.en: The act of helping or doing work for someone; a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities.

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.tr:
n. 计划；节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: He made a programme to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个存钱的计划。
words.en: A programme is a plan of activities designed to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.tr:
n. 组；群；集团；
v. （使）形成组；
words.ex: The students are in a group of five.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生组成一个五人小组。
words.en: A group is a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；家族；
adj. 家庭的；家族的；
words.ex: He belongs to the 587 family.
words.ex_cn: 他属于587家族。
words.en: A family is a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He picked up the telephone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A telephone is a device that you use to speak to someone in another place by dialing a number. It converts sound into electrical signals that can be sent over long distances.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.tr:
adj. 人的；人类的；
n. 人；人类；
words.ex: Human emotions are complex and powerful.
words.ex_cn: 人的情感复杂而强大。
words.en: A human is a member of the species Homo sapiens, distinguished from other animals by superior mental development, power of articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.ex: We went to the beach during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假日去了海滩。
words.en: A holiday is a day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: He is my friend.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的朋友。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: The organisation helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organisation is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: He made a choice to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 他选择努力学习。
words.en: If you have a choice, you can choose between two or more things.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: He plays soccer as his favorite sport.
words.ex_cn: 他把足球当作最喜欢的体育运动。
words.en: Sport is a physical activity that is governed by a set of rules or customs and often engaged in competitively.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: He uses a map to find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图找路。
words.en: A map is a visual representation of an area, showing physical features, cities, roads, etc., typically on a flat surface.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄是25岁。
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: The children play near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边玩耍。
words.en: A river is a large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.ex: He gave me a suggestion to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提了一个多吃蔬菜的建议。
words.en: A suggestion is an idea or plan that someone puts forward for consideration.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.ex: My parent helps me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母帮我做作业。
words.en: A parent is a mother or father.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: The visitor took photos of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位参观者拍了博物馆的照片。
words.en: A visitor is someone who is visiting a person or place.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: I take the bus to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天乘公共汽车去学校。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another.

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: He rowed the boat across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着小船渡过湖面。
words.en: A boat is a small vehicle for travelling on water.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.tr: n. 游泳；游泳运动； v. “swim”的现在分词；
words.ex: Swimming is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 游泳对健康有益。
words.en: the sport or activity of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: He loves to paint and study art.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢绘画和学习艺术。
words.en: Art consists of paintings, sculpture, and other pictures or objects which are created for people to look at and admire or think deeply about.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: He finished his homework task before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了他的作业任务。
words.en: A task is a piece of work to be done or undertaken.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.tr: n. 绘画；油画； v. 刷油漆；用颜料画；“paint”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves painting in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间绘画。
words.en: A painting is a picture which someone has painted.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.ex: I eat lunch at noon every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天中午吃午餐。
words.en: A meal eaten in the middle of the day, typically one that is lighter or less formal than an evening meal.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.ex: He passed the exam with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: The majority of students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority is the greater number or part of something.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: The company's sales increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售额增加了。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议上午九点开始。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.tr:
n. 问题；疑问；
v. 怀疑；询问；
words.ex: He asked a simple question in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上问了一个简单的问题。
words.en: A sentence or phrase used to find out information.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.ex: The farmer grows wheat on his land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农场主在他的土地上种植小麦。
words.en: A farmer is a person who owns or manages a farm.

words.ex: The first century had no computers.
words.ex_cn: 第一个世纪没有电脑。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years.

words.ex: He wrote his postcode on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮编写在了信封上。
words.en: A postcode is a sequence of letters and numbers which is part of an address and shows exactly where a place is.

words.ex: The government changed its education policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: A policy is a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.ex: The bird flies over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟飞过树。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.tr:
n. 鱼；鱼肉；
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；
words.ex: He caught a big fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鱼。
words.en: A fish is a creature that lives in water and has a tail and fins. Fish is also the flesh of a fish eaten as food.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.tr: n. 山；山脉；一大堆；大量；
words.ex: He climbed a tall mountain last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他爬了一座高山。
words.en: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides, much higher than a hill.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.ex: There is danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 河边有危险。
words.en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.ex: He made a quick decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about it.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.ex: I used my card to pay for the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的银行卡支付了杂货费用。
words.en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed, or a small rectangular piece of plastic containing personal data in a machine-readable form.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.ex: The teacher has an assistant to help with grading.
words.ex_cn: 老师有一个助理帮忙批改作业。
words.en: An assistant is a person who helps in particular work or who is under the authority of another person.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.ex: The children play on the street.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在街上玩耍。
words.en: A street is a road in a city, town, or village, usually with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.tr: n. 调查发现； v. 找到；发现；“find”的现在分词；
words.ex: The finding of the study surprised many scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的调查发现让许多科学家感到惊讶。
words.en: A finding is a discovery or conclusion reached as a result of an investigation or research.

words.tr:
n. 试验；测验；
v. 试验；测试；
words.ex: The scientist ran a test to see if the drug works.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行了一次试验，以查看这种药物是否有效。
words.en: A test is a series of questions or problems that is used to measure a person's ability or understanding of something.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: The children play by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边玩耍。
words.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

words.ex: The fish swim in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海里游泳。
words.en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.tr: n. （车辆等的）停放；停车场所；停车位； v. “park”的现在分词；
words.ex: There is no parking near the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校附近没有停车的地方。
words.en: Parking refers to the act of stopping a vehicle and leaving it temporarily in a particular place.

words.tr: n. 含意；可能的影响（或后果）；暗示；
words.ex: The implication of his words was that he was sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他话中的含意是他很抱歉。
words.en: An implication is a possible future effect or result of an action or decision, often one that is not immediately obvious.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: There was a big improvement in his English skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平有了很大改进。
words.en: The act of making something better or the state of being made better; an example or instance of this.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.tr: n. 安全；保障；防护措施；
words.ex: The school improved security to protect students.
words.ex_cn: 学校加强了安全措施以保护学生。
words.en: Security refers to the state of being free from danger or threat, or measures taken to ensure safety.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.ex_cn: 门上的数字是5。
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.tr:
n. 舞蹈；
v. 跳舞；
words.ex: She loves to watch the traditional dance.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢观看传统舞蹈。
words.en: To move your body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.tr:
n. 定量；配给量
v. 配给；定量供应
words.ex: He gets a small ration of food each day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天得到少量的食物配给。
words.en: A ration is a fixed amount of something such as food or fuel that is officially allowed to each person, especially when there is not enough of it available.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.tr:
n. 副本；(书，报纸等的) 一本；复制品；
v. 复制；
words.ex: Please give me a copy of the report.
words.ex_cn: 请给我一份报告的副本。
words.en: A copy is a thing made to be similar or identical to another. As a verb, to copy means to make a similar or identical version of something.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr: n. 烹饪； adj. 烹调用的； v. 烹饪；“cook”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cooking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of preparing food by heating it.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们正坐在教室里。
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.tr:
v. 提供；
n. 提供；提议；报价；
words.ex: He offers help to his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他向同学提供帮助。
words.en: If you offer something to someone, you ask them if they would like to have it or use it.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
